summary: Issue 49: task_files failed on feat/task-108-autonomy-stats because that branch merged main with a one-parent merge commit, so task_104 to task_107 (already on main, with other branches) looked added against the merge base. check_task_files now skips a task file that is byte-identical on the target branch, since merging it changes nothing. A new id or a changed file is still checked in full. Run on the real failing branch, the check went from failing to OK (13 task files checked). The failed branch's own task_108 is valid and untouched.
